texts.game: The game's Xbox Live Arcade package (the LIVE file from 58410A1B/000D0000/), or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xex and Data/).
texts.update: ilomilo Title Update #1 (the LIVE file of content type 000B0000, often in a folder named 2F5D19C7), or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xexp): this port is recompiled from the update's code, so it is needed.
texts.dlc: The "autumn tale" downloadable content, as the Xbox 360 package you have (a LIVE file of content type 00000002), or a folder of them. The game reads it in place from dlc/.
texts.settings: The game writes its settings file, ilomilo.toml, at its first start.
